responsibility: Implements the top-level Rust AST name-resolution driver. NameResolution initializes the global resolver with builtin types, establishes the crate’s root scopes and synthetic crate binding, then runs the two-pass resolution strategy over the crate—first collecting top-level declarations with ResolveTopLevel and then resolving item internals with ResolveItem—so later frontend stages can consume populated name/type/label bindings and canonical path mappings.
same_name_distinction: Defines the executable logic for the crate-level resolver entry point: it allocates the NameResolution singleton, initializes builtin type scope in the constructor, sets up crate/root ribs and module scope, creates the synthetic __$$crate__ binding, and runs the two-pass ResolveTopLevel/ResolveItem traversal. It differs from rust-ast-resolve.h by containing the actual orchestration code rather than just declaring the driver interface.
